query: UPDATE flow_node SET path = REGEXP_REPLACE(path,'u/' || $2 || '/(.*)','u/' || $1 || '/\1') WHERE path LIKE ('u/' || $2 || '/%') AND workspace_id = $3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_node d WHERE d.workspace_id = $3 AND d.hash_v2 = flow_node.hash_v2 AND d.path = REGEXP_REPLACE(flow_node.path,'u/' || $2 || '/(.*)','u/' || $1 || '/\1'))
